PMEX · Revenue Operating System for Healthcare

PMEX Portal Overview

The Technology Behind Every PMEX Service

PMEX isn't just a billing service, it's a technology platform that sits underneath everything PMEX does. Instead of one dashboard for billing, a separate spreadsheet for A/R, and a phone tree for communicating with your billing team, everything lives in one connected system.

The platform is built around a simple idea: your practice's data, your communications, and your billing partner's work should all be visible to you in real time, not locked away behind a monthly PDF.

PMEX does not sell or provide an EHR. The platform integrates with the EHR and practice management system your practice already uses, adding intelligence, CRM and reporting on top of it, not replacing it.
